summary: Frontend-only verification of three feature bundles for Xaluca Tours: (a) SideMenu sectioned reorganisation under 'Nuestros viajes', (b) Interactive Morocco map on HomePage, (c) BerberDivider injections across HomePage + 4 regional pages. ALL 6 review_request criteria PASS end-to-end on ES, EN and (for the menu/map text) FR-compatible paths. ZERO console errors and ZERO React pageerror events across the full run (homepage, /viajes/surdemarruecos, /viajes/marruecos, /viajes/nortedemarruecos, /viajes/escapadas, /en, hub /viajes/norte/tanger_fez).

side_menu.active_state_on_/viajes/surdemarruecos: aria-current=page + class contains text-[#D4A373] on menu-link-south — accent bar + accent text colour render correctly
side_menu.decorative_bg_present: berber-bg-diamond + radial gradients render inside tours group (visible in screenshot)

morocco_map_homepage.adventure_pill_highlights: centro path opacity=1, sur path opacity=1, norte path opacity=0.32 (dimmed) — correct

critical_code_review_comments: SideMenu.jsx renders sectioned tours group cleanly: initial state {tours: true} (line 34) correctly auto-expands the group on first open, and toggle still works. Icons map (lines 14-20) covers every icon referenced in menu.js — no missing icons.

MoroccoInteractiveMap.jsx: highlightedSet useMemo (lines 197-204) correctly handles the priority hoverRegion > activeCategory > activeRegion. 'full' and 'bespoke' categories correctly include all three regions ['norte','centro','sur'] (lines 133, 165) per the agent-to-agent note. CTA href computation (line 384) prefers active category routeId over region routeId — correct routing semantics.

BerberDivider.jsx: 3 inner variants each render their own data-testid; default export switch (lines 145-147) is straightforward. Component is pure / no side effects / no console noise. All 18 instances across 5 pages render cleanly.
Minor (non-blocking): MoroccoInteractiveMap.jsx imports `useRef, useEffect` (line 1) but doesn't use them — recommend cleanup but no functional impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 fully green for the side-menu reorganisation + interactive Morocco map + Berber dividers feature batch. Note for selector writing: many menu/map labels use CSS text-transform:uppercase, so prefer element.text_content() over inner_text() when string-matching Title Case copy in playwright tests. The 6 testids on the homepage map: morocco-map (section id), morocco-map-svg, map-region-{norte,centro,sur}, map-panel, map-panel-cta, map-region-pill-{id}, map-cat-{south,full,north,short,adventure,bespoke}. The 7 menu leaf testids are menu-link-{south,full,north,short,adventure,bespoke,departures} plus menu-tours-all header CTA. BerberDividers use 3 testids: berber-divider-{zellige,rug,nomadic}.
